description: Verification module that queries mcp_signal_scores via write_service to count distinct score values per signal_type. Outputs a report identifying which signals have fewer than 5 distinct values (weak signals per spec heuristic: BAD SIGNAL = SAME SIGNAL across all inputs). Targeted signals: permission_scope, temporal_stability, tool_description_safety. Query pattern: SELECT signal_type, COUNT(DISTINCT score) FROM mcp_signal_scores GROUP BY signal_type. No DB writes.
